content: function operator!= [SWS_CORE_00789] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename T, typename E> bool operator!= (const E &lhs, const Result < T, E > &rhs); Compare a Result instance for inequality to an error. A Result that contains no error is unequal to every error. A Result is equal to an error only if the Result contains an error of the same type, and the errors compare equal.
